description: This Kotlin source file defines the ShareFragment class, which allows users to select files and share them via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi using Android's sharing intents. It includes UI interactions, file handling, and sharing logic.

classes.name: ShareFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that enables users to pick files and share them through Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, also logs sharing history.

classes.name: SelectedFilesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying selected files with option to remove.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up button click listeners and initializes RecyclerView for displaying selected files.

methods.name: openFilePicker
methods.description: Launches Android's document picker to select files.

methods.name: confirmAndShare
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog before sharing files via selected methods.

methods.name: shareViaBluetooth
methods.description: Shares selected files using Bluetooth package.

methods.name: shareViaWifi
methods.description: Shares selected files via Wi-Fi with an intent chooser.

methods.name: shareSelectedFiles
methods.description: Constructs and launches the sharing intent based on selected files and method.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file via its URI.

methods.name: updateListState
methods.description: Updates UI based on whether files are selected or not.

methods.name: fileNameFromUri
methods.description: Extracts filename string from a URI.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the file picker, updating selected URIs.
